outcome: Integrate the seven academy repositories into private education-platform under existing common-harness contracts, review and preserve the broadest admitted practical/student context with bounded hierarchical retrieval, then deliver reviewed source and clean only dispositioned recoverable branches/worktrees.
criteria: Every unmerged source branch has an exact reviewed merge/reject/supersede disposition with recovery custody.
One explicit maintenance route exists for each of the seven repositories; common implementation remains owned by agent-platform.
Previously approved practical/student context has complete bounded inventory, preserved originals and scoped corrections, and a hierarchical read entrypoint without native/store duplication.
Current source checks and independent exact-head review pass before explicit expected-head publication/merge.
Root receives the integrated repository, merged base SHA, allowed path/privacy contract and operational PR readiness.
Authorized non-main branches/worktrees are cleaned after custody and effect reconciliation; Root operations and foreign work remain preserved.
